scope: Reviewed ordinary LONG index removal/fresh identity creation, computed and wildcard SELECT INTO, declared make-table inputs, explicit DISTINCTROW joined DELETE and documented compound type aliases.
qualification: Local release-mode implementation, independent complete-image, recovery and headless workflow checks. No native Microsoft Access/Windows execution.
observations: All recorded final Cargo commands use --release with the workspace-root target/ and no custom target directory.

Joined DELETE evaluates every ON/WHERE frame before deduplicating original target row handles. Target absence produces no synthetic handle. Existing local/correlated DELETE and joined UPDATE retain their owners; native TCND qualification remains unchanged.

Make-table fixed computed categories come from static output declarations even for empty/all-NULL results. Wildcards align exact native field names/types and preserve UTF16 capacity and Decimal precision/scale. Source keys, generation/defaults and Required metadata are not inherited.

Declared make-table inputs use the actual typed prompt then a separate native confirmation. Cancel/No preserve original bytes and prior results; Yes saves all retained rows atomically before ACK and full-image guarded reopen. SQL is not reevaluated.

Ordinary LONG DROP and fresh CREATE retain original logical identities, schema-only receipts, exact source/AFTER binding and V3 reconstruction. Primary/unique/compound/foreign and wider key families remain outside these saves.

Compound aliases are taken from Microsoft Access synonym entries, not guessed ANSI spellings. Existing native owners retain exact field widths and unsupported sized-Binary parameter/Binary ADD refusals.

retained_failures.reason: Computed negative tests omitted a required CStr number-format provider and used refused TOP0. Empty/all-NULL complete-image checks also exposed a raw trailing-fixed-field variable-ordinal error.

The computed raw oracle used zero instead of the current ordinary variable ordinal for a fixed field following Text and Decimal. Production construction was independently checked against the reference before correcting the raw builder.
New DropIndex effect was missing from the explicit catalog-publication match; repaired without wildcard fallback.
Historical pinned inputs had moved or changed. A separate read-only replay mirror restored exact Git blobs and existing immutable bytes; source and pins were not changed.
Removing an unused production Cause import exposed two test-only references; tests now import the real owner.
New prompt test accessed a sibling private field; replaced with the existing public shared UI observation rather than widening visibility.
Shared relation evaluator extraction omitted its Resource import, blocking downstream builds. Added the owning import.
Wildcard negative test requested nonexistent Table1 instead of its actual independent Items table. Corrected the selector; unsupported Binary still refuses.

interruption.meaning: The last debug-mode batch was intentionally stopped for the user-requested build-cache removal. Its partial results are not a completed pass.

independent_engineering_replay.meaning: Separate earlier engineering check against hash-pinned historical inputs; not a release-mode or Access comparison run.

presentation.reference: Retained Windows Access Home/datasheet capture opened directly. No corresponding DROP INDEX confirmation capture exists; compact warning layout is an adaptation.

limitations: One explicitly ignored Runtime fixture-dependent test did not execute; release Runtime totals are 438 passed and 1 ignored.
The query unit and selected integration scopes do not represent the entire query test corpus or a full ACE SQL conformance claim.
Native Windows/Access comparisons, older-profile mutations, wider index writes, required-program execution and other documented SQL gaps remain unqualified.
New numeric-index candidate and future originals are not activated or qualified by this checkpoint.
counting: 98 parser tests plus 1 doctest, 173 query unit tests, 2 compound-parameter and 12 mutation-scalar integration cases, 57 selected Access checks, 438 Runtime tests and 41 Desktop workflows. These cover different overlapping boundaries, not an additive conformance count.
